title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Up to 4 rubber ducks in bumper boats gather bubbles into tens together.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle your duck. Tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and BONK! In 🫧 Together every duck fills one shared jar: two rows of five, colours to sort and compare (one more than), your own ways to make a number, then tens and ones with ten rafts (tens first, then crossing a ten). Bubbles that don't fit bob away, so look before you paddle. Bump a stuck bubble free; in the frog pond, bump the frogs from the smallest number to the biggest. Dash into a raft to break a ten into ten ones. 💥 Bumper play has no clock: bump and bounce while the team makes exactly 50, then 70, then a number like 47. A raft is ten at once, but near the end only ones fit. Nobody is ever out!
learning: Counting to ten in rows of five, sorting by colour, one more than, number bonds, place value (tens and ones, adding tens, crossing a ten and regrouping), ordering numbers, cooperation and spatial awareness
